paletas.lila: clean white / very light lilac soft background with subtle blurred lilac blobs, lilac/violet corner line pattern (#a43ff1 at low opacity), headline in deep purple #3c0058, accent words in violet #a43ff1.

paletas.crema: warm cream background #eee6e1 with deep purple #3c0058 corner line pattern; headline deep purple #3c0058, accent words in violet #a43ff1.

tratamientos.color: The accent words are simply in the accent color, the biggest line.
tratamientos.grieta: The accent words are visibly BROKEN: split by a clean diagonal fracture line with the top half shifted a few pixels, like cracked glass — still perfectly readable.
tratamientos.bloque: The accent words are white on a solid violet #a43ff1 rounded block, with a subtle horizontal glitch slice (one thin band displaced sideways) — still perfectly readable.

prompt:
Create ONE vertical 9:16 Instagram Reels cover BACKGROUND DESIGN (exactly 1080x1920) for the Spanish-language creator "cvander" (Christian Van Der Henst). It must look like part of the SAME series as the style reference covers (estilo-*.jpg; the reciente-*.jpg ones are the latest approved): heavy bold condensed geometric sans-serif UPPERCASE headline, a visible geometric pattern of concentric arcs, dotted arcs and diagonal hatch lines in the corners, white rounded logo chips with the logo + name under it.
IMPORTANT: DO NOT draw any person. The lower area from y=980 to the bottom must stay clean background (pattern only at the far sides), because a real photo of Christian will be composited there later.

TEXT — use EXACTLY these words, spelled exactly like this, nothing added:
small tag line with wide letter-spacing and a short pink underline: "{tag}"
headline in {n} lines: {lineas}. Keep every accent mark.

LOGO CHIPS (only these, copied faithfully from {logos_ref}, never invented), in one row under the headline: {logos}. Each chip: the logo icon + its name under it, never the name twice.

LAYOUT: tag starts around y=470; headline and chips all inside x=143–937 and y=442–960. Top 15% and sides: pattern only. High contrast, readable as a tiny thumbnail. No other text, no watermark, no fake UI.
PALETTE: {paleta}
ACCENT: {tratamiento}
